component.name: NarwhalSlicer
component.summary: Strength calibration, optimization, simulation, and testing

description.p: NarwhalSlicer is an independent OrcaSlicer fork built for strength calibration, optimization, simulation, and testing of 3D-printed parts.

Set up loads and constraints, inspect estimated mechanical response, and apply localized reinforcement using native slicer modifiers. Strength analysis is experimental and requires validation against physical tests.
The project retains OrcaSlicer’s slicing tools and supported printer integrations.
